title: 烬·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 不对称白色剧场面具留着暗色眼孔，奶油色垂布呼应酒红细节。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Jhin is a slender adult masked performer with a smooth asymmetrical white theatrical mask, one dark eye opening, flowing cream cloth, burgundy accents, and refined armored costume panels. Preserve his tall elegant adult silhouette with fully covering sleeves, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. His ornate firearm remains secured in a closed fitted side case, never held, aimed, or presented toward the viewer.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: mask ivory, burgundy, lilac pencil shadow, restrained pale gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
